--------
Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam
Level: 20 (Max)
Cost: 8 Mana
Attack Speed: 80% of base
Attack Damage: 158.4% of base
Quality: +20% (augmented)
--------
Requirements:
Level: 70
Str: 155
Dex: 108
--------
The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc towards a target. While dual wielding, the damage is dealt by both weapons simultaneously. Gains Rage on hit.

Place into an item socket of the right colour to gain this skill. Right click to remove from a socket.
